notes: The San Francisco City Planning Commission's minutes of its regular meetings, July 1968 to December 1969, from the six quarterly volumes the San Francisco Public Library contributed to the Internet Archive. Each case prints a case number, the property - a street number, or a bearing from the nearest corner, or a block and lot - the request, the hearing, and the resolution and vote, which is what makes the minutes a dated record of two things no city dataset holds: what the Commission decided about a building, and what the staff said was standing on it at the time. Pages were split from the hOCR search text by the Internet Archive page index, so every citation names the viewer page the fact is on. A proposal is not a fact (LESSONS.md): a request in the future tense is carried only inside the decision entry, and what the minutes state as standing is a separate finding. The minutes are dense with people - applicants, objectors, representatives, commissioners and staff - and the reader spec barred every one of them from every field; companies, institutions, named buildings and the architects of a building are kept, architects in extra.reader_note.

coverage.remaining: Every page of the six volumes July 1968 - December 1969 (6minutesofsanfran1968sanf, 7minutesofsanfran1968sanf, 8minutesofsanfran1969sanf, 9minutesofsanfran1969sanf, 10minutesofsanfran1969san, 11minutesofsanfran1969san) was read. The collection holds 47 more volumes: 1970-1980 complete, then 1994-2005; 1981-1993 is in no volume, and nothing before July 1968 is digitised in this collection. Of the 209 unresolved, 142 located by block, corner or name only, with nothing to place it on, 27 no EAS record at the number, 14 a condominium parcel today, 12 a range now split across parcels, 6 other, 4 the record does not say which lot is which number, 2 a street EAS does not hold, 2 no parcel in the corner passing the lot, side and centreline tests.
coverage.note: 957 OCR pages with text across six quarterly volumes (1,856 scanned leaves, 899 of them blank or the verso the scanner captured twice). 286 cases heard, 180 of them about a property the minutes locate; 372 findings (198 statements of what stood on a property, 174 decisions the Commission took), read by six readers from one spec. Every quote was checked against its own page before the file was written and three were cut where they carried a speaker's name. 163 resolved on 110 parcels: 113 by the EAS join on a printed number, 46 by name on a building the minutes name and a page already carries, 4 by corner.py's corner test. 209 unresolved. 162 published on 91 pages, 44 of them seeded; 1 declined as the same decision stated on a second frontage.
